presets.name: Privacy
presets.what: Send Microsoft and apps as little as Windows allows.

presets.name: Clean Start & taskbar
presets.what: No ads, Bing, widgets or Copilot in Start and on the taskbar.

presets.name: Gaming
presets.what: Fewer interruptions and background recording while you play.

presets.name: Quiet Windows
presets.what: No tips, nagging, suggestions or surprise restarts.

tweaks.name: Activity history
tweaks.what: Windows records the apps and files you use and can upload the list. Clipboard history isn't affected.

tweaks.name: Feedback requests
tweaks.what: Windows asks you now and then to rate it or give feedback.

tweaks.name: Ads and news in Edge
tweaks.what: Edge's new tab news, shopping help, recommendations and other promotions. Edge itself keeps working.
tweaks.more: These are Edge policies, so Edge then says "Your browser is managed by your organization": that line comes from this tweak and goes away with Undo.

tweaks.name: Diagnostic data and ads ID
tweaks.what: Windows sends more than the required diagnostic data, tailors tips to it, gives apps an advertising ID, learns from your typing and inking, and sends speech to Microsoft. Off keeps only what Windows requires.
tweaks.more: Also turns off online speech recognition and the inking & typing dictionary.

tweaks.name: Tips and suggested content
tweaks.what: "Get tips and tricks", suggested apps and content in Settings and Start, and the "finish setting up your device" screens.

tweaks.name: Lock screen tips and facts
tweaks.what: Tips, fun facts and suggestions on the lock screen.

tweaks.name: Microsoft 365 ads in Settings
tweaks.what: Promotions for Microsoft 365 and Copilot on Settings' Home page.

tweaks.name: Suggested apps installed by Windows
tweaks.what: Windows installs promoted Store apps and games (Candy Crush and the like) on its own.

tweaks.name: Companion apps for new devices
tweaks.what: When you plug in a device (a mouse, a monitor), Windows downloads its maker's app.

tweaks.name: Location for Windows and apps
tweaks.what: Windows' location service, which apps, the weather and Find My Device use.

tweaks.name: Find My Device
tweaks.what: Windows saves this PC's location now and then so you can find it from your Microsoft account.

tweaks.name: Cloud results in search
tweaks.what: Search also shows files and mail from your Microsoft account and work or school account.

tweaks.name: Search history on this PC
tweaks.what: Start remembers what you searched for to suggest it again.

tweaks.name: Firmware programs at start-up (WPBT)
tweaks.what: Lets the PC's firmware make Windows run a program from the maker at every start (anti-theft tools, driver installers).
tweaks.more: Some laptops use this for anti-theft software (Absolute/Computrace). Desktops rarely need it.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Camera
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your camera. Off: Discord, Teams and games lose the camera.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Microphone
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your microphone. Off: Discord, games and calls lose the microphone, also the phone mic in apps.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Contacts
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your contacts.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Call history
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your call history.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Messages
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your text messages.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Email
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your email.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Tasks
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your tasks.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Calendar
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your calendar.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Radios
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on and off.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Documents
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your Documents folder.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Pictures
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your Pictures folder.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Videos
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your Videos folder.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: All files
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use every file on the PC.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Notifications
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your notifications.

tweaks.name: Apps can use: Account info
tweaks.what: Store apps and apps that ask Windows may use your name and account picture.

tweaks.name: Bing and Copilot in Start search
tweaks.what: Typing in Start also searches the web with Bing and offers Copilot. Off: Start searches this PC only.

tweaks.name: Recommended in Start
tweaks.what: Start's Recommended section: recent files, new apps, suggestions.

tweaks.name: Recently added apps in Start
tweaks.what: Start lists apps you installed lately at the top.

tweaks.name: Phone Link in Start
tweaks.what: Start shows your phone's apps and messages beside it (Phone Link).

tweaks.name: All apps in Start
tweaks.what: How Start lists every app.

tweaks.name: Previous Start layout
tweaks.what: Brings back Start's layout from before the 2025 redesign, on builds that still have it.

tweaks.name: Unpin everything from Start
tweaks.what: Removes every pinned app from Start for you (it starts empty, you pin what you want). Undo puts your pins back.
tweaks.label: Unpin all

tweaks.name: Taskbar icons
tweaks.what: Where the taskbar's icons sit.

tweaks.name: Search on the taskbar
tweaks.what: The search box, a smaller button, or nothing (Win+S still searches).

tweaks.name: Task view button
tweaks.what: The button for virtual desktops and open windows (Win+Tab does the same).

tweaks.name: Widgets
tweaks.what: The weather and news board on the taskbar and lock screen.

tweaks.name: Chat and Meet now
tweaks.what: The Teams Chat and Meet now buttons of older Windows versions.

tweaks.name: End task on right-click
tweaks.what: Right-clicking an app on the taskbar offers "End task", which closes it even when it hangs.

tweaks.name: Click goes to the last window
tweaks.what: Clicking an app with several windows opens the one you used last instead of showing them all.

tweaks.name: Combine buttons (main display)
tweaks.what: Whether an app's windows share one button, and whether names show.

tweaks.name: Combine buttons (other displays)
tweaks.what: The same for the taskbars on your other monitors.

tweaks.name: Show apps on
tweaks.what: With several monitors: which taskbars show an app's button.

tweaks.name: Battery percentage
tweaks.what: Shows the battery level as a number next to its icon.

tweaks.name: Notifications and calendar
tweaks.what: The notification centre and pop-ups from apps and Windows.
tweaks.more: Off also hides the calendar flyout from the clock. Deck's own pop-ups are its own window and keep working.

tweaks.name: Seconds in the clock
tweaks.what: The taskbar clock shows seconds.

tweaks.name: File extensions
tweaks.what: Shows .exe, .jpg, .txt after file names, so a "photo.jpg.exe" can't hide what it is.

tweaks.name: Hidden files and folders
tweaks.what: Shows files and folders marked hidden (like AppData).

tweaks.name: Protected system files
tweaks.what: Shows Windows' own protected files. Deleting or moving them can break Windows.

tweaks.name: File Explorer opens to
tweaks.what: The folder a new Explorer window shows.

tweaks.name: Home in the side pane
tweaks.what: Explorer's Home (recent and pinned files) in the left pane.

tweaks.name: Gallery in the side pane
tweaks.what: Explorer's Gallery (your photos) in the left pane.

tweaks.name: OneDrive in the side pane
tweaks.what: OneDrive in Explorer's left pane (OneDrive keeps syncing).

tweaks.name: USB drives listed twice
tweaks.what: Windows lists each USB drive under This PC and again on its own. Off: once.

tweaks.name: Your folders under This PC
tweaks.what: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos shown in This PC again.

tweaks.name: 3D Objects under This PC
tweaks.what: The 3D Objects folder of Windows 10.

tweaks.name: Music under This PC
tweaks.what: The Music folder in This PC (Windows 10).

tweaks.name: Drive letters
tweaks.what: Where drive letters show next to drive names.

tweaks.name: Folder type guessing
tweaks.what: Explorer looks at a folder's files to pick a view (Pictures, Music). In big folders that makes it slow to open.

tweaks.name: Long paths
tweaks.what: Programs that support it may use paths longer than 260 characters.

tweaks.name: Compact view
tweaks.what: Less space between items in Explorer's lists.

tweaks.name: Full path in the title bar
tweaks.what: Explorer's title shows the whole folder path.

tweaks.name: Recent files and frequent folders
tweaks.what: Home and Quick access list the files and folders you used lately.

tweaks.name: Check boxes to select files
tweaks.what: A tick box on each file for picking several without Ctrl.

tweaks.name: Classic right-click menu
tweaks.what: The full Windows 10 menu at once, without "Show more options".

tweaks.name: "Include in library"
tweaks.what: The Include in library entry on folders.

tweaks.name: "Give access to"
tweaks.what: The Give access to (sharing) entry.

tweaks.name: "Share"
tweaks.what: The Share entry on files.

tweaks.name: Dark mode
tweaks.what: Deck's Display page switches dark and light mode, also on a schedule.
tweaks.label: Open Display

tweaks.name: Transparency effects
tweaks.what: See-through Start, taskbar and window backgrounds.

tweaks.name: Animations
tweaks.what: Windows zoom when they minimise and maximise, and the taskbar animates.
tweaks.more: Off makes Windows feel snappier on a slow PC. Every effect one by one: Performance Options below.

tweaks.name: Visual effects (all of them)
tweaks.what: Windows' Performance Options, with every visual effect one by one.
tweaks.label: Open Performance Options

tweaks.name: Windows Spotlight on the desktop
tweaks.what: A new desktop picture every day from Bing.

tweaks.name: Scrollbars always visible
tweaks.what: Windows hides thin scrollbars until you hover. On: they always show.

tweaks.name: Accent colour on title bars
tweaks.what: Window title bars and borders use your accent colour.

tweaks.name: Blur on the sign-in screen
tweaks.what: The sign-in screen blurs the lock screen picture behind it.

tweaks.name: Window snapping
tweaks.what: Dragging a window to an edge snaps it to half or a corner.

tweaks.name: Snap suggestions
tweaks.what: After snapping a window, Windows suggests what to put beside it.

tweaks.name: Snap layouts
tweaks.what: The layout picker on the maximise button and at the top of the screen.

tweaks.name: Browser tabs in Alt+Tab
tweaks.what: Edge tabs show in Alt+Tab like windows.

tweaks.name: Sticky Keys shortcut
tweaks.what: Pressing Shift five times turns on Sticky Keys (and asks in the middle of a game).

tweaks.name: Num Lock on at start
tweaks.what: The number pad works right away after start-up.

tweaks.name: Game Mode
tweaks.what: Deck's CPU profiles set Game Mode; change it there so the two don't fight.
tweaks.label: Open CPU

tweaks.name: Game recording (Xbox Game DVR)
tweaks.what: Windows can record your games in the background, which costs some performance.

tweaks.name: Game Bar
tweaks.what: Win+G and the controller's Xbox button open the Xbox Game Bar.
tweaks.more: Off also stops the "You'll need a new app to open this ms-gamebar link" message after removing the Xbox apps.

tweaks.name: Mouse acceleration
tweaks.what: "Enhance pointer precision": the pointer goes further when you move faster. Off: the same hand movement always moves it the same distance.

tweaks.name: Fullscreen optimisations
tweaks.what: Windows runs fullscreen games through its desktop compositor (alt-tab is faster, overlays work). Off brings back old exclusive fullscreen for every game.

tweaks.name: Optimisations for windowed games
tweaks.what: Lets DirectX 10 and 11 games in a window use the faster flip model (lower latency, VRR).

tweaks.name: Variable refresh rate for windowed games
tweaks.what: G-Sync / FreeSync for games that don't support it themselves, in a window.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.what: The GPU schedules its own work (can lower latency; needed for DLSS frame generation).

tweaks.name: Multiplane overlay
tweaks.what: Lets the GPU show video and games as separate layers. Off fixes flicker and stutter on some NVIDIA setups, but can raise latency a little.

tweaks.name: Copilot
tweaks.what: Microsoft Copilot and its taskbar button.

tweaks.name: Recall
tweaks.what: Recall saves pictures of your screen to search later (Copilot+ PCs).

tweaks.name: Click to Do
tweaks.what: Windows looks at what's on screen to offer AI actions on text and pictures.

tweaks.name: AI service starts by itself
tweaks.what: Windows' AI service (WSAIFabricSvc) starts with Windows. Off: only when something needs it.

tweaks.name: AI in Edge
tweaks.what: Copilot in Edge's sidebar and on pages, AI writing help and AI history search.
tweaks.more: These are Edge policies, so Edge then says "Your browser is managed by your organization": that line comes from this tweak and goes away with Undo.

tweaks.name: AI in Chrome
tweaks.what: Gemini, Help me write, AI history search and other AI features in Chrome.
tweaks.more: These are Chrome policies, so Chrome then says "Managed by your organization": that line comes from this tweak and goes away with Undo.

tweaks.name: AI in Paint
tweaks.what: Cocreator, Image Creator, generative fill and erase in Paint.

tweaks.name: AI in Notepad
tweaks.what: Rewrite, summarise and other AI features in Notepad.

tweaks.name: Get updates as soon as they're out
tweaks.what: Windows installs new features before they reach everyone.

tweaks.name: Restart by itself after updates
tweaks.what: Windows may restart to finish an update while you're signed in (it waits for you when off).

tweaks.name: Share updates with other PCs
tweaks.what: Your PC uploads parts of updates to other PCs on the internet or your network.

tweaks.name: Drivers from Windows Update
tweaks.what: Windows Update installs drivers too, and can replace the GPU driver you chose.

tweaks.name: Store apps update by themselves
tweaks.what: Microsoft Store updates your apps in the background.

tweaks.name: Longest update pause
tweaks.what: How far Settings → Windows Update lets you pause (it doesn't pause anything by itself).
tweaks.more: A paused PC gets no security fixes either. Pause only as long as you need.

tweaks.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweaks.what: Connections try IPv4 first. IPv6 keeps working.

tweaks.name: Teredo
tweaks.what: An IPv6 tunnel over IPv4. Off can lower latency; Xbox party chat and some Game Pass multiplayer need it.

tweaks.name: DNS server
tweaks.what: Who turns names into addresses for this PC's connection. Automatic uses your router's.

tweaks.name: Network throttling for media
tweaks.what: While audio or video plays, Windows caps other network traffic a little. Off removes the cap.

tweaks.name: Hibernation
tweaks.what: Saves memory to disk to power off completely. Off frees hiberfil.sys (as big as a good part of your RAM) and also turns off fast start-up.

tweaks.name: Fast start-up
tweaks.what: Shut down saves part of Windows to disk to start faster. Off: real shutdowns (fixes dual boot and some driver problems).

tweaks.name: Detailed blue screens
tweaks.what: Blue screens show the technical details (driver and stop code) instead of the sad face only.

tweaks.name: Detailed start-up messages
tweaks.what: Start-up, sign-in and shutdown say what Windows is doing ("Applying settings…").

tweaks.name: Storage Sense
tweaks.what: Windows deletes temporary files and old Recycle Bin items by itself when space runs low.

tweaks.name: Reserved storage
tweaks.what: Windows keeps 7-10 GB free for updates. Off gives it back; turn it on again before a big feature update.

tweaks.name: Automatic device encryption
tweaks.what: New installs turn on BitLocker device encryption by themselves. Off stops that; it never decrypts a drive that is already encrypted.

tweaks.name: Network while asleep (Modern Standby)
tweaks.what: The laptop stays online while asleep for mail and updates.

tweaks.name: Hardware clock in UTC
tweaks.what: For dual booting with Linux, which keeps the clock in UTC: stops the time jumping by hours between them.

tweaks.name: Settings Home page
tweaks.what: Settings opens on Home (recommendations and ads). Off: it opens on System.

tweaks.name: Lock screen
tweaks.what: The picture screen before sign-in. Off goes straight to the sign-in box.

tweaks.name: Windows Sandbox
tweaks.what: A throwaway Windows in a window for trying unknown programs (Pro, Enterprise).

tweaks.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
tweaks.what: Run Linux tools and distributions on Windows.

tweaks.name: Memory integrity (core isolation)
tweaks.what: Windows checks every driver in a protected area, which stops kernel malware. Some old drivers and tools need it off; it can cost a few % in games.
tweaks.more: FACEIT and some anti-cheats require it on, and Windows Security warns while it's off.

tweaks.name: SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.what: Preloads programs you use often into memory. Helps hard drives; on an SSD it mostly writes to the disk.

tweaks.name: Windows Search indexing
tweaks.what: Indexes your files so Start and Explorer find them fast. Off saves disk work; searches get slow (Deck's own search keeps working).

tweaks.name: Store apps in the background
tweaks.what: Store apps may run in the background (for notifications and live tiles).

tweaks.name: Warnings for unsigned RDP files
tweaks.what: Windows warns before opening a Remote Desktop file nobody signed.

tweaks.name: Brave extras
tweaks.what: Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN, Leo AI, News, Talk and Tor windows.

tweaks.name: Edge extras and data sharing
tweaks.what: Edge's first-run pages, shopping, rewards, collections, desktop shortcut and data sharing. Edge and WebView2 stay installed.
tweaks.more: These are Edge policies, so Edge then says "Your browser is managed by your organization": that line comes from this tweak and goes away with Undo.
